+title: 'Queue metrics: GenerationQueue records depth and task timing for the model queue and the admission queue'
+---
+## What
+
+`GenerationQueue` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/GenerationQueue.swift`) is the work queue of each model and also the admission queue of the pool. It records no metric. It does not separate the wait time from the run time, and it does not know its name or its model.
+
+Change:
+- `GenerationQueue.init` takes an internal `QueueTelemetry` (from the shared recorder task). Keep `public init()` with the default name `generation`, so that the public API does not break.
+- `ModelPool.swift:21` (`Entry.queue`): make the queue with name `model` and `model.ref` = the key of the entry.
+- `ModelPool.swift:79` (`admissions`): make the queue with name `admission`, with no model.
+- `Job` (`GenerationQueue.swift:151`):
+  - keep a `QueueTicket` from `enqueued()` when the job is counted in `enqueue(_:resume:)` (`:102`)
+  - call `started` in `run()` (`:225`) before the detached task runs `body`
+  - call `completed` in `finish()` (`:245`), with `succeeded` or `failed` from the result
+  - call `completed(…, .cancelled)` in `cancel()` (`:205`) for a job in `.waiting`
+  - make sure that each job calls `completed` exactly one time, under the same state lock that makes exactly one path resume the submitter
+- Do not change the lock order that `GenerationQueue.swift:16-19` documents. Record the metrics outside the `unfinished` lock.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] Each completed job records `queue.wait`, `queue.run` and `queue.tasks` with `queue.name` = `model` (with `model.ref`) or `admission`.
+- [ ] `queue.depth` goes up for each job that waits or runs, and goes back to 0 when the queue is idle.
+- [ ] A job cancelled before start records `cancelled` and no run time. A job cancelled while it runs records its run time and `cancelled` when the body throws `CancellationError`.
+- [ ] The existing order tests of `GenerationQueue` and `ModelPool` still pass.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Add tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/GenerationQueueTests.swift` with `TestMetrics`: two jobs in sequence give a wait time for the second job that is not less than the run time of the first job. Also test the depth values and the cancelled paths.
+- [ ] Add a test in `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/ModelPoolTests.swift` that an acquire records an `admission` task, and that an embed through a hold records a `model` task with the right `model.ref`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #feature
\ No newline at end of file

I moved that refusal to a new `refuse(_:)` that `enqueue` calls after it releases the `unfinished` lock. It records `cancelled` (no run time), then resumes. Thus no metric is recorded under the `unfinished` lock, and the lock order is not changed.
-    - Each path records `completed` before it resumes the submitter, so the depth is 0 when `submit` returns.
-    - `ModelPool`: `Entry.queue` is now set by `makeResident` with `QueueTelemetry(name: .model, model: key.ref)`; `admissions` uses `QueueTelemetry(name: .admission)`.
-    - Note: the eviction job of the last hold release is put in the admission queue under the pool locks, thus its `enqueued()` meter increment occurs under the pool locks (not under the `unfinished` lock). No metrics code takes a pool lock.
